_readme.what: Config-driven pool list for the seeder. Keyed by chainId (string). Each value is an array of pools to create + seed on that chain. Copy this file to pools.json and edit, or point seed.sh at any file via SEED_POOLS=/path/to/file.

token.WETH: use the chain's wrapped-native (from the deployment record's weth9). The seeder auto-wraps native ETH -> WETH if your WETH balance is short (except on Tempo).
token.MINT: deploy a fresh MockERC20 (test token) and mint a big supply to the deployer. Give it name/symbol/decimals. Use this on chains where you hold no stablecoin.
token.ADDRESS: an existing token you already hold; provide address + decimals.
token.fields: kind, address(ADDRESS only), name(MINT only), symbol, decimals

pool.label: free-text description (logged only)
pool.priceAperB: human price = how many units of tokenB you get per 1 unit of tokenA. For a WETH/tUSDC pool with tokenA=WETH, tokenB=tUSDC, priceAperB=2500 means 1 WETH = 2500 tUSDC. Drives the v3 initial sqrtPrice. (For v2, price is set by the deposit RATIO, so keep amountA:amountB consistent with priceAperB.)
pool.amountA: human amount of tokenA to deposit
pool.amountB: human amount of tokenB to deposit (keep amountB ~= amountA * priceAperB so v3 uses both sides)
pool.range: v3 ONLY: 'wide' (full usable range, snapped to tickSpacing) or 'concentrated' (a +/- band around the current tick, width = rangeTicks tickSpacings)
pool.rangeTicks: v3 concentrated ONLY, optional (default 50): half-width of the band in tickSpacings

_readme.sizing: Amounts are DEMO-scale on purpose. Technical minimum for a v3 position is a few dollars; a usable demo that quotes sanely is ~$200-500 of value per side. Sepolia is free (faucet + MINT tokens).
